description: This class includes the sawing, planing and machining of wood into primary forms such as planks, beams and boards.
includes: sawing or chipping of wood: planks, beams, boards, sleepers, props
manufacture of wood wool, wood flour, chips, particles
impregnation and chemical treatment of wood
manufacture of railway or tramway sleepers of wood
manufacture of telegraph poles of wood
excludes: manufacture of fibre building boards, see 1621
